You can edit this text via a Resource Editor such as ResEdit.

Inside the file "Scenario" that resides inside each scenarios folder is a resource of Type "TEXT"  Edit this text as you wish and give it an ID of -200 through -300.  Open the "Scenario" file with ResEdit and you will see a resource of type "TEXT" that you can edit.

In the "Map Editor" place the ID in the "Scrolling Text ID" field and this text will be displayed as a scrolling message isntead of a normal map.
